description: Lets the real CI-Server web app (served remotely at http://127.0.0.1:8642 / http://localhost:8642 after the bootstrap page's window.location.replace()) read, write and remove its device key in the OS keychain: tauri-plugin-ci-auth's secure_get, secure_set and secure_remove, and nothing else from that plugin. The plugin's loopback sign-in commands and its `ci-auth:default` set are deliberately not granted. The web side namespaces every key it stores (`memory:` in @ci/common's nativeBridge.ts). This is the desktop replacement for keeping the key in window.localStorage.
